changes.title: Trump urges calls to Arkansas Sen. Tom Cotton in push for permanent daylight saving time
changes.summary: "If Tom Cotton were putting Arkansas first, he would give them an extra hour of daylight and, more importantly, they wouldn't have to run all over their houses, farms, work places, and everywhere else, twice a year, having to change their Clocks, and often forgetting to do so," Trump said on social media.

changes.title: Trump urges calls to cellphone of Arkansas Sen. Tom Cotton in battle over permanent daylight saving time bill
changes.summary: President Donald Trump urged supporters to call what appears to be the senator's personal cellphone number.

changes.title: Trump appears to post Sen. Tom Cotton’s cell number in push to make daylight saving time permanent
changes.summary: President Donald Trump on Saturday appeared to share Sen. Tom Cotton’s cellphone number in a social media post amid a push to make daylight saving time permanent nationwide.
